{
  "function": "async () => {const {parseTransitions,TuringMachine}=await import('/turing-machine-simulator/src/core.ts');const rules=parseTransitions(document.querySelector('#rules').value);const m=new TuringMachine({blankSymbol:'0',initialState:'G.seed',acceptStates:[],rejectStates:[],haltStates:['G.HALT'],transitions:rules.transitions},[]);let result; const start=performance.now(); for(let i=0;i<20000000;i++){result=m.step();if(result.stopped)break;}const values=m.tape.entries().filter(([p])=>p>=0).map(([,v])=>Number(v));return {reason:result.reason,steps:m.stepCount,terms:values.length,last:values.at(-1),first:values.slice(0,9),ms:Math.round(performance.now()-start)};}"
}
